leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the useId hook to generate unique IDs within a React component.
Apply generated IDs to HTML attributes like 'for' and 'id' to ensure accessibility in form elements.
Construct a component that uses useId to create stable IDs across server and client rendering.
Configure multiple related elements by deriving stable IDs from a single useId call.
Update a component to replace hardcoded IDs with useId for improved SSR compatibility.
Manipulate the base ID string from useId to create custom, scoped ID prefixes.
